items.question: Can this foundation support more pages later?
items.answer: Yes. The design system is modular, so future pages can reuse the same tokens and components.

items.question: Is the content fully localized?
items.answer: The visible text comes from structured translation files, so each locale can be updated independently.

items.question: Does this include banking workflows?
items.answer: No. It is an informational website foundation only, with no authentication or transactions.
